question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 guide: revenue $108B±2%, GM 74%, GAAP opex $9.2B, tax 16-18%. Typical beat implies revenue ~$111-113B -> GAAP EPS ex-investment gains ~$2.53-2.56 at ~24.25B diluted shares (non-GAAP consensus ~$2.47-2.53 less ~$0.065 SBC). GAAP has exceeded non-GAAP lately because equity gains flow through other income ($16.4B in Q1, $7.8B in Q2). In the quarter ending ~Oct 25, Intel dipped slightly ($92.3 -> $87.0, the crash came after quarter-end), SpaceX rose (~$124 -> $147.5), CoreWeave and Nebius fell sharply, and Anthropic had not yet IPO'd, so net gains look near zero to mildly positive, with wide uncertainty. No human market found on Polymarket/Manifold; Kalshi not verified (any EPS contracts there likely use adjusted EPS, a contract mismatch).

calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) the size of the neocloud losses. Run 2's -$3-6B is not supported by the dossier prices: Intel (~-$1.2B) plus CoreWeave (~-$0.8B) is ~-$2B, and Nebius/IREN add perhaps -$0.5-1B. I side with Run 3's arithmetic. (2) The SpaceX gain: only Run 1 included it; the price rise is documented in the dossier, but the ~$21B stake size is unverified, so I count it partially. (3) The OpenAI round closing before quarter-end cannot be settled; I keep it as right-tail risk. (4) Timing: the Intel crash (Oct 30) and the Anthropic S-1/IPO are after quarter-end; the runs agree and this is settled. Judgment: private marks are probably positive given the last two quarters. Core operating EPS ~$2.50-2.56 is agreed by all three runs. The result is a median of $2.58, near Runs 1 and 3, because the evidence (not averaging) argues against Run 2's larger loss estimate.
